arxiv-2107-02596.title: Chiral conformal field theory for topological states and the anyon eigenbasis on the torus
arxiv-2107-02596.creator: Hua-Chen Zhang, Ying-Hai Wu, Tao Xiang, and Hong-Hao Tu
arxiv-2107-02596.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hua-Chen Zhang, Ying-Hai Wu, Tao Xiang, and Hong-Hao Tu. Model wave functions constructed from (1+1)D conformal field theory (CFT) have played a vital role in studying chiral topologically ordered systems. There usually exist multiple degenerate ground states when such states are placed on the torus. The common practice for dealing with this degeneracy within the CFT framework is to take a full correlator on the torus, which includes both holomorphic and antiholomorphic sectors, and decompose it into several conformal blocks.

arxiv-2111-11337.title: Network-wide Multi-step Traffic Volume Prediction using Graph Convolutional Gated Recurrent Neural Network
arxiv-2111-11337.creator: Lei Lin, Weizi Li, Lei Zhu*
arxiv-2111-11337.description: Abstract Accurate prediction of network-wide traffic conditions is essential for intelligent transportation systems. In the last decade, machine learning techniques have been widely used for this task, resulting in state-of-the-art performance. We propose a novel deep learning model, Graph Convolutional Gated Recurrent Neural Network (GCGRNN), to predict network-wide, multi-step traffic volume.

arxiv-2205-13201.title: The profinite completion of relatively hyperbolic virtually special groups
arxiv-2205-13201.creator: Pavel Zalesskii
arxiv-2205-13201.description: Abstract We give a characterization of toral relatively hyperbolic virtually special groups in terms of the profinite completion. We also prove a Tits alternative for subgroups of the profinite completion G ^ \widehat{G} of a relatively hyperbolic virtually compact special group G G and completely describe finitely generated pro- p p subgroups of G ^ \widehat{G} .

arxiv-2210-14822.title: Efficient search for superspecial hyperelliptic curves of genus four with automorphism group containing ℤ 6 \mathbb{Z}_{6}
arxiv-2210-14822.creator: Momonari Kudo, Tasuku Nakagawa, Tsuyoshi Takagi
arxiv-2210-14822.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Momonari Kudo, Tasuku Nakagawa, Tsuyoshi Takagi. In arithmetic and algebraic geometry, superspecial (s.sp. for short) curves are one of the most important objects to be studied, with applications to cryptography and coding theory. If g ≥ 4 g\geq 4 , it is not even known whether there exists such a curve of genus g g in general characteristic p > 0 p>0 , and in the case of g = 4 g=4 , several computational approaches to search for those curves have been proposed.

arxiv-2507-13345.title: Imbalance in Balance: Online Concept Balancing in Generation Models
arxiv-2507-13345.creator: Yukai Shi, Jiarong Ou, Rui Chen, Haotian Yang, Jiahao Wang, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Di Zhang, Kun Gai
arxiv-2507-13345.description: Abstract In visual generation tasks, the responses and combinations of complex concepts often lack stability and are error-prone, which remains an under-explored area. In this paper, we attempt to explore the causal factors for poor concept responses through elaborately designed experiments. We also design a concept-wise equalization loss function (IMBA loss) to address this issue.

britannica-1911-beech.title: Beech (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-beech.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-beech.description: Article 'Beech' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 3), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The beech is one of the largest British trees, particularly on chalky or sandy soils, native in England from Yorkshire southwards, and planted in Scotland and Ireland. It is one of the common forest trees of temperate Europe, spreading from southern Norway and Sweden to the Mediterranean. It is found on the Swiss Alps to about 5000 ft.

pmc-10706678.title: The Pattern and Influencing Factors of Opioid-Prescribing Behavior Among Emergency Physicians: A Cross-Sectional Study in the Western Region of Saudi Arabia
pmc-10706678.creator: Hamdan Alrajhi, Sawsan Hanafi, Malak BinShihon, Mahmoud Halawani
pmc-10706678.description: BackgroundIn the last two decades, drug overdose has globally become a major player in patients’ morbidity and mortality events. Opioids, in particular, have been always the main part of this equation in different communities as they correspond, for instance, to one-third of poisoning deaths in The United States of America (USA).

pmc-11541791.title: Experimental Study on Optimizing Hydrogen Production from Sludge by Microwave Catalytic Pyrolysis Using Response Surface Methodology
pmc-11541791.creator: Wenchang Qin, Hailong Yu, Chaoqian Wang, Shuting Qin, Xiaolong Li
pmc-11541791.description: Catalytic pyrolysis technology is a harmless and useful solid waste treatment method. Studying the catalytic pyrolysis of sludge for hydrogen production is of practical significance. Therefore, this paper prepared a bifunctional catalyst with both microwave absorption and catalytic properties from electroplating sludge through carbonization and acid modification processes and then was characterized by XRD, BET, SEM, XPS, and FTIR.

pmc-11669468.title: Concentration, motivation, activity, and subjective fatigue in patients with single-sided deafness
pmc-11669468.creator: Emre Gürses, Samet Kılıç, Bünyamin Çıldır
pmc-11669468.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate four dimensions of fatigue, including subjective fatigue severity, concentration problems, reduced motivation, and activity in patients with single-sided deafness.MethodsFollowing audiological assessment, the Checklist Individual Strength scale and Montreal Cognitive Assessment were performed on 41 adults with single-sided deafness and 41 sex-matched adults with normal bilateral hearing in the study group and control group, respectively.

pmc-11859906.title: Post-traumatic stress in healthcare workers during the COVID-19 pandemic: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11859906.creator: Z Athimni, N Belhadj Chabbeh, S Chatti, F Chelly, L Ben Afia, M Bouhoula, A Chouchane, A Aloui, I Kacem, M Maoua, A Brahem, H Kalboussi, O El Maalel
pmc-11859906.description: IntroductionDuring the COVID-19 pandemic, healthcare professionals worked under critical care conditions and had to adapt quickly to extreme work situations. They were confronted with several occupational stressors.ObjectivesTo determine the prevalence and factors associated with post-traumatic stress symptoms among healthcare personnel at Farhat Hached Hospital in Sousse during the COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-12535386.title: Oxidative Addition of Aryl Bromides at Palladium(I) to form Palladium(III) Complexes
pmc-12535386.creator: Bailey S Bouley, Dae Young Bae, Wen Zhou, Leonel Griego, Liviu M Mirica
pmc-12535386.description: Herein, we report the first systematic study of the oxidative addition of aryl bromides to a PdI center to generate organometallic PdIII complexes. These isolable PdIII complexes stabilized by tetradentate macrocyclic pyridinophane ligands exhibit distinct UV–vis and EPR spectroscopic signatures that allowed for the monitoring of their generation in situ.

pmc-12651334.title: Position of Maxillary Lateral Incisor and First Premolar in Impaction of Maxillary Canines: A Controlled Clinical CBCT and 3D Study Model Analysis
pmc-12651334.creator: Maja Hočevar, Maja Ovsenik, Aljaž Golež, Andrea Scribante, Stefania Cantore
pmc-12651334.description: Objectives: This study examined the link between impacted maxillary canines and changes in the position of adjacent lateral incisors (LIs) and first premolars (FPs), as well as opposite canines. It also explored the relationship between the position of impacted canines and the presence of palpable mucosal bulges.

pmc-12654845.title: Sex-Specific Autoimmune Comorbidity Patterns in Pemphigus Vulgaris and Bullous Pemphigoid: A Bicenter Retrospective Case–Control Study
pmc-12654845.creator: Özge Zorlu, Serkan Yazici, Sidar İlik, Emel Bülbül Başkan, Hülya Albayrak, Sema Aytekin
pmc-12654845.description: Background and Objectives: While pemphigus vulgaris (PV) and bullous pemphigoid (BP) have been linked to autoimmune comorbidities, the spectrum and specificity of these associations remain uncertain. We aimed to investigate the prevalence and patterns of autoimmune diseases (AIDs) in patients with PV and BP compared with age- and sex-matched controls.

pmc-12860066.title: Clinical diagnosis and treatment of bowel endometriosis and the distribution characteristics of lesions
pmc-12860066.creator: Haining Jiao, Weiwei Feng, Hua Liu
pmc-12860066.description: BackgroundBowel endometriosis (BE) is a complex condition that can present with diverse clinical manifestations, impacting the quality of life for affected individuals. This retrospective case series aimed to investigate the clinical characteristics, diagnosis, treatment, and lesion distribution of BE.MethodsEighty-eight patients with pathologically confirmed BE who underwent surgery at Shanghai Rui-jin Hospital between January 2013 and September 2024 were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-12995829.title: TBCRC 035: randomized phase II pharmacodynamic study of standard and reduced-dose palbociclib with endocrine therapy in hormone receptor (HR)-positive previously treated metastatic breast cancer
pmc-12995829.creator: S Jacob, EL Mayer, N Kacik, AM Storniolo, C Isaacs, I Mayer, V Stearns, R Nanda, J Nangia, AJ Chien, M Moasser, M Melisko, C Wabl, A Muzikansky, J Geradts, DA Dillon, BH Park, I Krop, AC Wolff, B Kochupurakkal, GI Shapiro, HS Rugo
pmc-12995829.description: BackgroundThe cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 inhibitor palbociclib induces neutropenia, resulting in dose delays and reductions.Patients and methodsThis multicenter phase II trial randomly assigned patients with metastatic hormone receptor-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative breast cancer to receive palbociclib 100 mg versus 125 mg with fulvestrant or tamoxifen; cross-over was allowed.

pmc-13158395.title: Biofilm synergy by Agrobacterium deltaense and Bacillus velezensis in co-cultures indicates bacterial interspecific cooperation
pmc-13158395.creator: Yue Zhang, Zhigang Wang, Weihui Xu
pmc-13158395.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Rhizosphere microorganisms typically coexist within complex multispecies biofilm communities. However, the interspecies interactions within these biofilm-associated microbial consortia remain largely unexplored. A synthetic bacterial SynCom Q was previously constructed in our laboratory for controlling watermelon Fusarium wilt. This study simplified SynCom Q into SynCom Y (Agrobacterium deltaense LSQ16 and Bacillus velezensis WB) using a stepwise strain omission strategy and combined genome-scale modeling with multi-omics analyses to reveal mechanisms of synergistic biofilm formation. deltaense LSQ16 and B. velezensis WB significantly enhanced biofilm formation.
